fusions.name: Concussive Screech
fusions.desc: Screams a cone of sound 5 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns each enemy for 1 second.

fusions.name: Ricochet Ping
fusions.desc: Sends a pulse of sound into the first enemy it meets, where it deals 7 damage, then rebounds to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that each. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave [Vibrant Echo] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Deafening Clap
fusions.desc: After a 1-second wind-up, claps your hands together and holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Stronger After Dusk
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
